notes: True homograph of the existing H7034 ("treat with contempt"), both spelled קלה -- added as קלה¹ per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H7034 was retroactively renamed to קלה² in this same batch. H7034's own notes already anticipated this exact collision.

Niphal ("be inflamed", Ps.38.8, נִקְלֶה, "my loins are filled with burning") is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check. Its surface form is identical to H7034's own niphal participle (also נִקְלֶה) but the corpus tags it H7033 specifically, and the verse's sense (a burning/inflamed affliction) matches H7033's "scorch" meaning, not H7034's "be despised" -- confirmed as correctly tagged, not cross-contamination.
